items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 32:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the five Gevurot of the internality? The GAR of the five Gevurot are called the five Gevurot of the internality, and the VAK of the five Gevurot are called the five Gevurot of the externality. For the aspect of GAR is always called by the name internality, and the aspect of VAK is called by the name externality. (Item 76).
